tx-travis-2026-ccl2-dippel-leslie.name: Leslie Dippel
tx-travis-2026-ccl2-dippel-leslie.bio: Executive County Attorney in the Travis County Attorney's Office, where she has served for over 20 years.

tx-travis-2026-ccl4-malhotra-dimple.name: Dimple Malhotra
tx-travis-2026-ccl4-malhotra-dimple.bio: Judge of Travis County Court at Law #4 for over six years; previously led Travis County's Protective Orders Division and family violence units.

tx-travis-2026-ccl5-espiritu-mary-ann.name: Mary Ann Espiritu
tx-travis-2026-ccl5-espiritu-mary-ann.bio: Presiding judge of Travis County Court at Law #5 since January 2023; former private-practice defense attorney and Texas Department of Public Safety staff attorney.

tx-travis-2026-ccl7-earle-elisabeth.name: Elisabeth Earle
tx-travis-2026-ccl7-earle-elisabeth.bio: Presiding Judge of Travis County Court-at-Law #7; former Austin Municipal Court judge and Travis County Attorney's Office prosecutor.

ny-erie-2026-supreme-court-joynt-anne.name: Anne E. Joynt
ny-erie-2026-supreme-court-joynt-anne.bio: Attorney who has practiced for more than twenty years in Western New York courts representing injured workers, abuse survivors, and families.

ny-erie-2026-supreme-court-richardson-ro.name: Robert N. Richardson
ny-erie-2026-supreme-court-richardson-ro.bio: Confidential law clerk to State Supreme Court Justice Frank Caruso since 2007; previously worked in the Erie County District Attorney's office.

ny-erie-2026-supreme-court-tripi-deanne.name: Deanne M. Tripi
ny-erie-2026-supreme-court-tripi-deanne.bio: Erie County Family Court judge, first elected in 2013 and re-elected in 2023.

ny-erie-2026-buffalo-city-court-pacifico.name: Michael J. Pacifico
ny-erie-2026-buffalo-city-court-pacifico.bio: Attorney who has served as a public defender, assistant Erie County attorney, and confidential law clerk to a New York State Supreme Court supervising judge.

ny-kings-2026-civil-court-cascio-linda.name: Linda Lo Cascio
ny-kings-2026-civil-court-cascio-linda.bio: Court Attorney-Referee in Brooklyn courts for 11 years; former solo practitioner and trial attorney.

ny-kings-2026-civil-court-felix-celeste.name: Celeste Felix
ny-kings-2026-civil-court-felix-celeste.bio: Principal Law Clerk in Kings County Supreme Court, Civil Branch; former Administration for Children's Services agency attorney.

ny-kings-2026-civil-court-ortiz-christin.name: Christine G. Ortiz
ny-kings-2026-civil-court-ortiz-christin.bio: Attorney serving in the New York State Unified Court System in Kings County since 2015.
